generation.explanation: The 68-95-99.7 rule (empirical rule) describes how data spreads in a normal distribution: roughly 68% of values lie within 1 standard deviation of the mean, 95% within 2σ, and 99.7% within 3σ. These nested bands are a quick way to reason about probability without integrating the density. Drag the mean or use the slider to explore how the shaded regions stay centered on μ.
